baslermuenster.name: Basel Minster
baslermuenster.slogan: Red sandstone above the Rhine, two towers left of five.
baslermuenster.line: A 1356 earthquake destroyed five towers and the choir; only two towers were rebuilt, and the last was finished in 1500.

kunstmuseumbasel.name: Kunstmuseum Basel
kunstmuseumbasel.slogan: Holbein to Picasso under one roof, owned by the city since 1661.
kunstmuseumbasel.line: Its collection began in 1661, when the city and university bought the Amerbach Cabinet, making it the first municipal museum open to the public.

augustaraurica.name: Augusta Raurica
augustaraurica.slogan: A Roman colony on the Rhine, still mostly under the fields.
augustaraurica.line: Its theatre held 8,000 to 10,000 people, the largest Roman theatre north of the Alps, and about 80% of the city is still unexcavated.

fondationbeyeler.name: Fondation Beyeler
fondationbeyeler.slogan: Monet and Picasso in a Renzo Piano glass box among the meadows.
fondationbeyeler.line: When it opened on 18 October 1997 it showed 140 modern classics, including 23 Picassos.

stursannecollegiale.name: Saint-Ursanne
stursannecollegiale.slogan: A medieval town in a bend of the Doubs, entered over a stone bridge.
stursannecollegiale.line: The town is named for Ursicinus, a seventh-century Irish monk who founded a monastery on the Doubs.
